title: transport canonicalization probe
target_automorphism_context: Schlaefli/E6 graph has W(E6) symmetry in the mathematical model; full orbit enumeration was not attempted with NetworkX VF2 because it is too slow for the 27-line graph in this connector session.
conclusion: BT1795 is not unique as a literal transport: even the first 1000 VF2 embeddings split across 504 distinct 18-line images, and the source hypergraph already has 216 automorphisms. The right canonical object is therefore an orbit under source automorphisms and Schlaefli/E6 target automorphisms, not a single map.
